name: Tripadi International
positioning: Manufacturer and exporter of stainless steel, brass and copper hospitality metalware — chafing dishes, wine coolers, trays, charger plates and buffet service.

owner.name: Rajendra Sharma
owner.bio_short: Rajendra Sharma has spent over thirty years at the bench and on the factory floor in Moradabad, India's metal-craft city. Tripadi International is his own factory — every piece that carries the name is made under his roof and passes his hand before it ships.

processes: Sheet metal spinning and deep drawing
Sand casting and gravity die casting (brass)
Buffing, mirror polishing and satin finishing
Electroplating — nickel, chrome, silver, gold, antique

certifications.name: EPCH membership (Export Promotion Council for Handicrafts)

capacity.moq_policy: MOQ varies by item and finish. Stock finishes start lower; custom finishes and branding carry a higher minimum.

trade.payment_terms: 30% advance against Proforma Invoice, balance against copy of B/L. L/C at sight accepted for orders above a threshold.
trade.packing: Individual poly + bubble, master carton, 5-ply export carton. Pallets on request.

retail.gst_note: Prices shown are inclusive of GST at 18%. CONFIRM the correct HSN-wise rate before go-live.
